entries.en: Dodger still ain't here? That’s one long-ass drive.
entries.ro: Dodger tot n-a ajuns? Ce drum lung, frate.

entries.en: How the fuck should I know?
entries.ro: De unde pula mea să știu?

entries.en: Was supposed to be here, like, an hour ago.
entries.ro: Ar fi trebuit să fie aici de vreo oră.

entries.en: Yup, 'cept he's not. Riddle me that.
entries.ro: Da, dar nu e. Dezleag-o tu, dacă poți.
